news.headline: 副總統范斯：黃仁勳不需要特赦，華府調查壓力仍在升高
news.headline_en: Vance says Jensen Huang won't need a pardon as scrutiny of Nvidia scandal builds in Washington
news.plain: 美國副總統范斯表示，司法部與國安官員已確認黃仁勳「沒有被調查」。但國會仍要追問：黃仁勳 12/1 將接受眾議院情報、外交、中國特別委員會閉門詢問，12/3 出席參議院銀行委員會公開聽證，焦點是他與疑似中國間諜人士的關係，以及董事會在川普施壓下讓他回任是否獨立。
news.plain_en: VP JD Vance said Justice Department and national security officials confirmed Huang is under no investigation. Congress still wants answers: Huang faces a closed-door interview with the House Intelligence, Foreign Affairs and China committees on Dec 1 and a public Senate Banking hearing on Dec 3, focused on his tie to a suspected Chinese spy and whether the board acted independently in reinstating him under pressure from Trump.
news.why_me: 這是治理與政治風險，不是輝達的訂單或獲利變差。下週聽證會前後股價可能大起大落；你的規則不變：輝達不加碼，占比超過 20% 才考慮減碼。
news.why_me_en: This is a governance and political risk, not a hit to Nvidia's orders or profits. Expect big swings around next week's hearings. Your rule stays: don't add NVIDIA, and consider trimming only above 20%.
news.source: 美聯社 AP（ABC News 轉載）

news.headline: 台股反彈 956 點收 39,151 點，台積電反而小跌
news.headline_en: Taiwan stocks rebound 956 points to 39,151 while TSMC slips
news.plain: 台股週四在前一天重挫後反彈 2.5%，電子類股帶頭，上漲家數近千檔；但台積電跌 5 元，外資仍賣超約 492 億元，已連續賣超多日。
news.plain_en: Taiwan stocks bounced 2.5% Thursday after the prior day's plunge, led by electronics, with nearly 1,000 stocks rising. But TSMC fell NT$5 and foreigners still sold about NT$49.2B, extending their selling streak.
news.why_me: 0050 跟著反彈，台積電沒跟上。台股距 10 月高點仍跌超過 20%，屬熊市區間；照規則，台股部位暫不增加科技曝險，不用追漲也不用恐慌賣出。
news.why_me_en: 0050 bounced; TSMC lagged. TAIEX is still more than 20% below its October peak, in bear-market territory. Per your rules, don't add Taiwan tech exposure; no need to chase or panic-sell.

news.headline: 新台幣強升 1.79 角，收 32.947 元
news.headline_en: Taiwan dollar jumps 0.179 to close at 32.947
news.plain: 前一天新台幣重貶跌破 33 元後，週四隨台股反彈強力回升 1.79 角，回到 33 元以內。
news.plain_en: After breaking past 33 the day before, the TWD rebounded 0.179 Thursday alongside the stock bounce, moving back inside 33.
news.why_me: 台幣回升，你的美股換算台幣的價值會小幅下降，輝達占比也跟著降低。匯率每天來回，不需要為此動作。
news.why_me_en: A stronger TWD slightly lowers the TWD value of your US stocks, which also trims NVIDIA's weight. FX swings daily; no action needed.

valuation.name: Google
valuation.note: 採用預估本益比、P/B、殖利率三法；PEG 因 EPS 含投資收益、成長率被灌水而排除。Morningstar 450 只當樂觀參考。
valuation.note_en: Uses forward P/E, P/B and dividend-yield methods; PEG excluded because investment gains inflate EPS growth. Morningstar $450 is an optimistic reference only.

valuation.name: 輝達
valuation.note: 5 年平均本益比 32 倍含 AI 泡沫期，不採用；殖利率法（股息太少）與 PEG（試算表公式誤植，且 95% 成長不可持續）也排除。改用預估 EPS × 15～20 倍（S&P 500 約 18 倍），並以 P/B 286 交叉驗證。
valuation.note_en: The 32x five-year average P/E reflects bubble years, so it is not used; the yield method (tiny dividend) and PEG (sheet formula error, 95% growth unsustainable) are excluded too. Uses forward EPS × 15–20x (S&P 500 is about 18x), cross-checked with P/B 286.

valuation.name: 嬌生
valuation.note: 四種方法都在 165～210 之間，結論一致：現價明顯偏貴。PEG 98 偏低（成長率被專利到期拉低）不採用。
valuation.note_en: All four methods land between 165 and 210, a consistent verdict: the current price is clearly expensive. PEG (98) is excluded as patent expiries depress growth.

valuation.name: 博通
valuation.note: 預估本益比與 PEG 都在 390 上下；P/B 受 VMware 併購影響偏低，只當下限參考；殖利率法股息太少不採用。
valuation.note_en: Forward P/E and PEG both land near 390; P/B is depressed by the VMware deal and serves only as a floor; the yield method is excluded (dividend too small).

valuation.name: 高通
valuation.note: 預估本益比、殖利率、PEG 都在 128～143；P/B 受大量買回扭曲不採用。
valuation.note_en: Forward P/E, yield and PEG all land between 128 and 143; P/B is distorted by heavy buybacks and excluded.
